Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Wetherby Asset Management Has Raised Its Position in Microsoft (MSFT) as Valuation Rose; Synchrony Finl (SYF) Share Value Declined While Clearbridge Cut Position 
April 16, 2018 - By Linda Rogers 
Wetherby Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 1.89% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wetherby Asset Management Inc bought 3,828 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 206,209 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.64M, up from 202,381 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wetherby Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $716.70 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.53% or $0.5   $93.08. About 19.71M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500. 
Clearbridge Llc decreased its stake in Synchrony Finl (SYF) by 0.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clearbridge Llc sold 12,960 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.73% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.87 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $149.28 million, down from 3.88M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clearbridge Llc who had been investing in Synchrony Finl for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $25.90B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.18% or $0.76   $34.07. About 5.73 million shares traded. Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) has declined 0.21%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 11.76% the S&P500. 
Analysts await Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) to report earnings on April, 27. They expect $0.79 EPS, up 29.51% or $0.18 from last year’s $0.61 per share. SYF’s profit will be $600.63M for 10.78 P/E if the $0.79 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.70 actual EPS reported by Synchrony Financial for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 12.86% EPS growth. 
Among 29 analysts covering Synchrony Financial ( NYSE:SYF ), 21 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 72% are positive. Synchrony Financial had 72 analyst reports since July 20, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Conviction Buy” rating by Goldman Sachs given on Wednesday, January 13. The rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy” on Wednesday, June 15. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, November 23 by Sterne Agee CRT. As per Wednesday, May 31, the company rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets. The rating was maintained by Keefe Bruyette & Woods with “Buy” on Thursday, December 21. Bank of America downgraded the stock to “Hold” rating in Friday, October 6 report. Morgan Stanley maintained Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) on Monday, October 23 with “Equal-Weight” rating. The rating was maintained by BTIG Research on Monday, July 17 with “Buy”. BMO Capital Markets maintained Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) on Wednesday, April 12 with “Buy” rating. As per Wednesday, September 16, the company rating was downgraded by BMO Capital Markets. 
Clearbridge Llc, which manages about $5.40B and $4.80B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Aecom (NYSE:ACM) by 582,500 shares to 1.31 million shares, valued at $48.59M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Veeco Instrs Inc Del (NASDAQ:VECO) by 68,540 shares in the quarter, for a total of 747,390 shares, and has risen its stake in Healthsouth Corp (NYSE:HLS). 
Since February 16, 2018, it had 0 insider purchases, and 3 selling transactions for $930,912 activity. 
Wetherby Asset Management Inc, which manages about $3.65 billion and $720.69M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 8,199 shares to 149,278 shares, valued at $25.26 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Altaba Inc by 5,631 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 5,151 shares, and cut its stake in Vanguard Intl Equity Index F (VEU).   Linda Rogers
